title: TrashCans issue #58: [Crash] AdvancedAE's Extended Export Bus too fast(?) for Item Trash Can
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by engdyn]
### Minecraft version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Trash Cans version

1.1.0

### Game environment

Client

### Steps to reproduce

1. Attach an Extended Export But to an Item Trash Can
2. Add 2+ Acceleration Cards to the export bus
3. Add item to export
4. Observe crash

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f4630ce9-fcfa-4057-bc9f-ebf44e2218a3

### Crash report (~/logs/latest.log)

All the Mons - 1.3.0 crashed. The logs have been uploaded to `paste.kostromdan.dev`:
### [latest.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/0nred9u>)   |   [debug.log head](<https://p.kdan.dev/U8w5XtJ>) / [tail](<https://p.kdan.dev/ZUZ6oUC>) (~15MB & ~90k lines)   |   [crash-2026-09-23_16.51.16-server.txt](<https://p.kdan.dev/QZXyvGa>)   |   [PrismLauncher-0.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/3QQDgxa>)   |   KubeJS: [client.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/ByQ9tPa>) / [server.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/tMrU4Mi>) / [startup.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/QdLx0W0>)   |   [crash_assistant_app.log](<https://p.kdan.dev/HBcbufP>)   |   [modlist.txt](<https://p.kdan.dev/ASMHrxw>)

### [Mod list changes](<https://p.kdan.dev/VS1eRZd>) on top of the modpack:
```ansi
5 added, 0 removed, 0 updated.
```

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
This issue was due to Minecraft 1.21+ arbitrarily throwing an error when saving a stack with size greater than 99. Most likely something was inserting such a large stack into the trash can.
It should be fixed not in Trash Cans version 1.1.1.
Thank you for reporting the issue!

[comment by engdyn (none)]
Just tried it out and everything works now. Thank you!
